question_text: Where are U-turns prohibited?

options.text: On motorways
On clearways for motor vehicles only
On farm or forest tracks

correct_answers.text: On motorways
On clearways for motor vehicles only

comment: You may not turn your vehicle on freeways or motorways. Reverse driving is strictly prohibited on both types of roads as well.

question_text: Why do you have to wait before the left turn?

options.text: - motorbike
- car
- bicycle

correct_answers.text: - motorbike

comment: As a left-turning driver, you generally have to give priority to oncoming traffic. Cyclists also have this right of way. So, in this situation you have to let the motorcyclist pass before turning. He will pass the left-turning driver from the right and continue straight ahead.

question_text: What is the right course of action?

options.text: - once the [red] vehicle has overtaken me
- now in order to make the carriageway clear
- now so that following vehicles will not be confused by my slowing down

correct_answers.text: - once the [red] vehicle has overtaken me

comment: If you want to turn left and a car wants to overtake you from the left, you have to let it pass first. Only after the car has completed its overtaking maneuver, you may turn yourself.

question_text: You want to turn left. What is the right course of action?

options.text: I stop at the farm track and wait
I accelerate and swiftly take the turn
I continue driving, because I cannot turn off the road here

correct_answers.text: I stop at the farm track and wait

comment: Since you are currently being overtaken, it is not possible to turn left. You must wait for the overtaking process to be finished before you can turn left.

question_text: In this situation, why do you have to wait before the left turn?

options.text: - motorbike
- [red car]
- [bicycle]

correct_answers.text: - motorbike

comment: In this situation, you need to wait for the motorbike behind the car to pass before turning left

question_text: What is the right course of action in this situation?

options.text: - after [the red car] has overtaken me

- now, so that my hesitation does not create any uncertainty in the minds of those behind me

correct_answers.text: - after [the red car] has overtaken me

comment: In this situation, you should first wait for the motorcycle to overtake you before turning left.

question_text: Why are you not allowed to turn off the road now?

options.text: - [red car]
- bus
- oncoming traffic

correct_answers.text: - [red car]

comment: The red car is overtaking and is travelling to your left. To avoid a collision, do not turn off now under any circumstances. Check whether your indicators are dirty and therefore cannot be seen.

question_text: You want to turn left at the next junction. What is the right course of action now?

options.text: I remain behind the stationary vehicles
I indicate left
I drive carefully to the left past the stationary vehicles

correct_answers.text: I remain behind the stationary vehicles
I indicate left

comment:
If you drive past the waiting vehicles, you could obstruct oncoming vehicles and, in the worst case, block the entire road.
Therefore, start to flash left now to signal to other road users that you want to turn into the road. Also, stay behind the waiting vehicles and only turn off when you reach the road.

question_text: You want to turn left. Which line should you steer?

options.text: The middle driving line
The left driving line
The right driving line

correct_answers.text: The middle driving line

comment: Keep to the centre line when turning left. This allows you to drive as far to the left as possible without driving in the opposite lane and the motorbike behind you can pass you on the right.

question_text: You want to turn left. Which line should you follow?

options.text: The middle driving line
The left driving line
The right driving line

correct_answers.text: The middle driving line

comment: You should keep as far to the left as possible when turning left. However, you are riding in a one-way street where cycling is permitted in both directions. You are therefore not allowed to ride on the far left because cyclists may be coming towards you. Therefore, follow the centre line.

question_text: You want to turn left. Which line should you follow?

options.text: The left driving line
The middle driving line
The right driving line

correct_answers.text: The left driving line

comment: If you want to turn left in a one-way street, you should keep as far to the left as possible, so follow the left lane.

question_text: What is the right course of action when reversing?

correct_answers.text: - ensure the road area is safe by additionally looking all around me
- drive slowly and attentively
- make sure that no-one is located in my blind spot

comment: When reversing, look to the rear and additionally secure the traffic area by looking all around, drive attentively and slowly and, for safety reasons, make sure that there are no persons in the blind spot.

comment: To drive backwards from a property to a road, it is not enough just to use the rear view camera. You should be instructed on the street if necessary and keep in mind that pedestrians have priority.

question_text: When turning right, there is a risk of overlooking cyclists travelling straight ahead in the blind spot. How can you reduce this risk?

options.text: I monitor the traffic behind and to the side at short intervals
I make sure the mirrors are adjusted correctly
I make sure that accessories in the cab do not obstruct the view

correct_answers.text: I monitor the traffic behind and to the side at short intervals
I make sure the mirrors are adjusted correctly
I make sure that accessories in the cab do not obstruct the view

comment:
When a bus or truck turns right, there is a risk of overlooking cyclists driving straight ahead in the blind spot. To minimize the risk, you should observe the following and side traffic at short intervals, make sure that your mirrors are adjusted correctly and ensure that no accessories are obstructing your view.
This way you can recognize cyclists in good time and avoid accidents.
